steps: Growth of 3% per year multiplies the population by 1 + 3/100 = 1.03 each year.

commonErrors.likelyCause: The growth rate was used where the growth factor was needed.
commonErrors.remediation: Check the model at t = 1: it must exceed the starting value for growth, not shrink it.

steps: A grows by a fixed amount each year, so after t years it has increased by 94t — growth proportional to t.
B is multiplied by 2 each year, so after t years it has been scaled by 2^t — growth proportional to an exponential in t.
An exponential with ratio greater than 1 eventually outgrows any linear function, regardless of the starting values or the size of the constant increase.
So B eventually exceeds A and remains ahead.
